entries.clue: Cubes you rattle and then blame when the roll goes badly
Hot fried potato pieces from the paper, best with a small wooden fork
Row of fabric panels on poles, hammered in to shelter the family picnic
Crumbly chocolate finger stuck into the top of a 99
Sewing aid that became a cherished mover in a certain money game
Slim projection at a wall's corner, housing a lookout or a spiral stair
Lay letter tiles for a triple-word score, then dare anyone to challenge it
Hired singer who earned his supper retelling old heroics between courses
Water-filled ditch that made scaling ladders useless and tunnelling a drowning risk
Honey-fermented drink raised in the hall long before hops came into fashion
Great tower at the heart of a stronghold, the last refuge once the walls were lost
Rectangle of terry cloth to lie on, dry off with, then shake out for hours
Buttery vanilla sweet cut from a slab in the seaside gift shop.
